Select: compound_records.compound_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles, metabolism.met_conversion, metabolism.pathway_key
Source: metabolism, compound_records, compound_structures
Join: metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id AND compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Filter: metabolism.met_id IS NOT NULL
Sort: metabolism.met_id ASC
Limit: 200
